dialogues.jp:
別に楽しみにしてるわけじゃないんだが、今日
はさくらの授業がなかった。
dialogues.en:
We didn't have Sakura's class today. Not that I look forward
to her class, but...
dialogues.text:
We didn't have Sakura's class today. Not that I look forward
to her class, but...

dialogues.jp: まったりとした月曜日の放課後だ。
dialogues.en: It's an ordinary Monday after school.
dialogues.text: It's an ordinary Monday after school.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「おーい、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「眞子、久しぶりだな、部活か？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Mako. Long time no see. Do you have a club activity
today?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Mako. Long time no see. Do you have a club activity
today?"

dialogues.jp: 昇降口までの帰り道に珍しいやつと鉢合わせる。
dialogues.en:
On the way home, I run into a person whom I haven't seen for
a long time.
dialogues.text:
On the way home, I run into a person whom I haven't seen for
a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まぁね。あんたは元気にやってる？　どうな
　のそっちは？」
dialogues.en: "Yes, kind of. How about you? Are you doing okay?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, kind of. How about you? Are you doing okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あいかわらずだ」
dialogues.en: "Same as always."
dialogues.text: "Same as always."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「また、かったるいとか言ってるんでしょ。噂
　の幼なじみティーチャーはどんな反応してる
　の？」
dialogues.en:
"You still say everything's a pain in the neck, don't you?
How's your childhood friend the teacher?"
dialogues.text:
"You still say everything's a pain in the neck, don't you?
How's your childhood friend the teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや、意外と普通に授業やってるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, she teaches all right."
dialogues.text: "Oh, she teaches all right."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「そうなの？　あ、まぁ、冗談で講師なんてやっ
　てたら洒落にならないか」
dialogues.en:
"Really? Well, she could be a joke if she's not serious
about teaching."
dialogues.text:
"Really? Well, she could be a joke if she's not serious
about teaching."

dialogues.jp: あはは、と眞子が後頭部に手をやる。
dialogues.en: Mako reaches around the back of her head with a laugh.
dialogues.text: Mako reaches around the back of her head with a laugh.

dialogues.jp: 「冗談が洒落にならないのか？」
dialogues.en: "The joke's too true to be funny?"
dialogues.text: "The joke's too true to be funny?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「言葉の綾でしょうが……細かいところに茶々
　いれないの」
dialogues.en:
"It's just a figure of speech. Don't try to butt in with
something funny."
dialogues.text:
"It's just a figure of speech. Don't try to butt in with
something funny."

dialogues.jp:
あいよ、と軽く肩をすくめて、俺は窓際の壁に
よりかかる。
dialogues.en:
I shrug my shoulders while leaning against the wall near the
windowsill.
dialogues.text:
I shrug my shoulders while leaning against the wall near the
windowsill.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、音夢、どうしてる？」
dialogues.en: "So, how's Nemu doing?"
dialogues.text: "So, how's Nemu doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ……あんまり良くないかな。日常生活に
　はそんなに問題ないんだけど、外に出て歩き
　回ったりは無理っぽいな」
dialogues.en:
"Um... She's still not feeling well. It doesn't interfere
with her daily life, but she can't walk around outside yet."
dialogues.text:
"Um... She's still not feeling well. It doesn't interfere
with her daily life, but she can't walk around outside yet."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「しかし、特に本校に来ても変わらないな」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I think attending the main school is any
different."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I think attending the main school is any
different."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そう、面白いこともあるよ」
dialogues.en: "Really? It's more fun, though."
dialogues.text: "Really? It's more fun, though."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どんな？」
dialogues.en: "What kind?"
dialogues.text: "What kind?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うん、前は付属の最上級生だったけどでも今
　は本校の最下級生になったわけじゃない……、
　これって部活内では結構変わるもんなの」
dialogues.en:
"Well, in the last school, I was one of the oldest, but now
I'm one of the youngest, which affects me in clubs."
dialogues.text:
"Well, in the last school, I was one of the oldest, but now
I'm one of the youngest, which affects me in clubs."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「今までは本校の人は、年長者みたいな感じで
　接してくれてたけど、今は下級生扱いになっ
　てるのよ」
dialogues.en:
"They treated me as a senior before, but now, they treat me
as a lower-grade girl."
dialogues.text:
"They treated me as a senior before, but now, they treat me
as a lower-grade girl."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「グループが一緒になったから、急に自分に近
　い年下だって認識したわけか」
dialogues.en:
"When they get together, they must realize you are junior to
them."
dialogues.text:
"When they get together, they must realize you are junior to
them."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そう。棲み分けってやつかな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it's like I'm living separately from them."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it's like I'm living separately from them."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
あまり先輩後輩って間柄のやつはいないので、
いまいち実感はしづらいな……萌先輩は別格だ
し。
dialogues.en:
I don't really notice feeling senior or junior because I
don't have any particular such relationship myself.
dialogues.text:
I don't really notice feeling senior or junior because I
don't have any particular such relationship myself.

dialogues.jp: 「……そういえば杉並が寂しがってたぞ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I remember now. Suginami misses you."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I remember now. Suginami misses you."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ」
dialogues.en: "What does that mean?"
dialogues.text: "What does that mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや、からかう相手がいないって」
dialogues.en: "He said he doesn't have anybody to tease."
dialogues.text: "He said he doesn't have anybody to tease."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「寂しがらせときなさいよ！」
dialogues.en: "Let him miss me!"
dialogues.text: "Let him miss me!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……俺に怒るなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't get angry at me."
dialogues.text: "Don't get angry at me."

dialogues.jp:
なるほど面白い、とか考えつつ、手を闘牛をな
だめるように広げる。
dialogues.en:
Entertained, I spread my arms as if I were calming a
bullfight.
dialogues.text:
Entertained, I spread my arms as if I were calming a
bullfight.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あのさ……ひとつだけ失礼なこと聞いてもい
　い？」
dialogues.en: "Listen... Can I ask you a rude question?"
dialogues.text: "Listen... Can I ask you a rude question?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「失礼なことって？」
dialogues.en: "Rude question?"
dialogues.text: "Rude question?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うん。ちょっと朝倉の知り合いの噂を確認し
　たくてさ……それもあんまりいい噂じゃなく
　て」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I want to check with you about a bad rumor I heard
about your friend."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I want to check with you about a bad rumor I heard
about your friend."

dialogues.jp: 周囲を気にしながら眞子が呟く。
dialogues.en: Mako lowers her voice, worried about her surroundings.
dialogues.text: Mako lowers her voice, worried about her surroundings.

dialogues.jp:
そういうことに無頓着というより、嫌っている
こいつにしては珍しいことだ。
dialogues.en:
It's rare for her to care about gossip. She usually hates
it.
dialogues.text:
It's rare for her to care about gossip. She usually hates
it.

dialogues.jp:
「本当に珍しいな、お前がそういうことに首突っ
　込むなんて」
dialogues.en: "I've never seen you stick your neck into gossip before."
dialogues.text: "I've never seen you stick your neck into gossip before."

dialogues.jp: 別に構わないと、気楽に首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: She shakes her head, saying she doesn't care.
dialogues.text: She shakes her head, saying she doesn't care.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あのさくらって子いるじゃん。普段はどんな
　性格してるの？」
dialogues.en: "You know Sakura, right? What kind of person is she?"
dialogues.text: "You know Sakura, right? What kind of person is she?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「さくらのこと？　あー、単純で直球勝負で、
　からかいがいがありつつ、意外とマメな感じ
　かな。そうじて子供だ」
dialogues.en:
"Sakura? Oh, she's simple, down-to-earth and a perfect
target for teasing, but a dedicated person, and she's very
childish, too."
dialogues.text:
"Sakura? Oh, she's simple, down-to-earth and a perfect
target for teasing, but a dedicated person, and she's very
childish, too."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり噂になってる……って、別に失礼で
　もなんでもないだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"You said a rude question, but that's not rude at all,
though."
dialogues.text:
"You said a rude question, but that's not rude at all,
though."

dialogues.jp:
だが、眞子の眉がさらにハの字になって、目も
細められる。
dialogues.en: But I see Mako screw up her eyes and frown.
dialogues.text: But I see Mako screw up her eyes and frown.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あのさ、どうせ耳に入るだろうから言ってお
　くけど、噂になってるんだよ、あの子のこと」
dialogues.en:
"All right, sooner or later, you'll find out, so I'll tell
you now, people are talking about her."
dialogues.text:
"All right, sooner or later, you'll find out, so I'll tell
you now, people are talking about her."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「自分を笑ったりいじめたりした人に、怪我を
　させたり、故意に事故を起こしたりしてるっ
　て……」
dialogues.en:
"Saying that if anyone teases her or laughs at her, she
makes them have an accident or inflicts an injury on them on
purpose."
dialogues.text:
"Saying that if anyone teases her or laughs at her, she
makes them have an accident or inflicts an injury on them on
purpose."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
あまりにも寝耳に水な話で、いったい誰のこと
なのかと考えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
This is totally out of the blue. I'm not sure who she is
talking about.
dialogues.text:
This is totally out of the blue. I'm not sure who she is
talking about.

dialogues.jp:
「え……さくら……いや、同じ名前で別人だろ
　う、それ？」
dialogues.en: "Uhh... Sakura... No, it must be a different person."
dialogues.text: "Uhh... Sakura... No, it must be a different person."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あの外見で見間違えるわけないでしょ……事
　故とかの現場で目撃されて、後で名前を調べ
　たから、そんな間違いじゃない――って」
dialogues.en:
"Everybody can recognize her. She was seen at the site of
the accident and they already checked her name. So it's not
a mistake... that's what they say."
dialogues.text:
"Everybody can recognize her. She was seen at the site of
the accident and they already checked her name. So it's not
a mistake... that's what they say."

dialogues.jp: それは、どこかで――
dialogues.en: I remember I heard it somewhere...
dialogues.text: I remember I heard it somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『ほら、バイト帰りに桜の枝が頭にぶつかった、
　風紀委員の子がいたじゃないですか』
dialogues.en:
'Do you remember the girl in the discipline committee who
got hurt with a cherry branch on her head on the way home
from her part time job?'
dialogues.text:
'Do you remember the girl in the discipline committee who
got hurt with a cherry branch on her head on the way home
from her part time job?'

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それで、あの子のこと笑ったから、その仕返
　しだって……」
dialogues.en:
"And that girl laughed at her. They say that's why she did
it, in revenge."
dialogues.text:
"And that girl laughed at her. They say that's why she did
it, in revenge."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『いや、それが、バイト中に怒らせちゃったら
　しいんですよ。子供扱いして』
dialogues.en:
'Well I heard she made Sakura angry by treating her like a
child at her part-time job.'
dialogues.text:
'Well I heard she made Sakura angry by treating her like a
child at her part-time job.'

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あくまで噂よ！　……あたしだって信じ
　てないよそんなの」
dialogues.en:
"It's only a rumor, okay? I don't wanna believe that,
either."
dialogues.text:
"It's only a rumor, okay? I don't wanna believe that,
either."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
『だから、自分が頭を打ったときに、桜の木の
　陰から芳乃先輩がじっと｛にら／睨｝んでたって』
dialogues.en:
'And she said when the girl hit her head, Sakura was
watching her from behind the cherry tree.'
dialogues.text:
'And she said when the girl hit her head, Sakura was
watching her from behind the cherry tree.'

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「たださ……なんか今回の噂は、本当の事故と
　重なってて嫌なんだよ……冗談にならないよ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't like that the rumor went out at the same time the
accident happened. It's not funny at all."
dialogues.text:
"I don't like that the rumor went out at the same time the
accident happened. It's not funny at all."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「後輩に聞いてさ、そんな証拠もないことで騒
　ぐなって注意してるんだ。でも、さくらちゃ
　んは傷ついてるはずだから――」
dialogues.en:
"I've been telling my juniors not to spread that kind of
gossip without proof. I know Sakura must be hurt by this."
dialogues.text:
"I've been telling my juniors not to spread that kind of
gossip without proof. I know Sakura must be hurt by this."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとな眞子」
dialogues.en: "Thanks, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Thanks, Mako."

dialogues.jp: もういい、と手で言葉をさえぎる。
dialogues.en: I make a gesture telling her that's enough.
dialogues.text: I make a gesture telling her that's enough.

dialogues.jp:
眞子にしても、俺の関係者だから、なおさら関
わらずにはいられなかったのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Mako must feel obligated to help me since we are good
friends.
dialogues.text:
Mako must feel obligated to help me since we are good
friends.

dialogues.jp:
「安心しろ……あいつはそんなことするやつじゃ
　ない」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. She's not that kind of person."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. She's not that kind of person."

dialogues.jp: ニヤリと笑う。
dialogues.en: I give a grin.
dialogues.text: I give a grin.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……うん。分かった」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「学生の噂ってのは、講師じゃどうにもならな
　いからさ」
dialogues.en:
"A teacher can't do anything about a rumor among the
students."
dialogues.text:
"A teacher can't do anything about a rumor among the
students."

dialogues.jp:
どん、と俺の胸を手の甲ではたいて、眞子が去っ
ていく。
dialogues.en:
Slapping my chest with the back of her hand, Mako walks
away.
dialogues.text:
Slapping my chest with the back of her hand, Mako walks
away.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうだな」
dialogues.en: "She's right."
dialogues.text: "She's right."

dialogues.jp: 眞子に叩かれて熱くなっている胸をさする。
dialogues.en: I stroke my warm chest that Mako hit.
dialogues.text: I stroke my warm chest that Mako hit.

dialogues.jp:
大人と違って、俺達にはそういう噂の証拠なん
ていらないんだな……面白ければ。
dialogues.en:
Unlike adults, we don't need any proof of rumors if they're
interesting.
dialogues.text:
Unlike adults, we don't need any proof of rumors if they're
interesting.

dialogues.jp: こういうときになって、初めて気づいた。
dialogues.en: I realized something for the first time.
dialogues.text: I realized something for the first time.

dialogues.jp:
だけど、さくらはまだ俺達と同じで、大人にな
りきれていないんだ。
dialogues.en: Sakura is still immature, just like us.
dialogues.text: Sakura is still immature, just like us.

dialogues.jp: 「……またなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Again?"
dialogues.text: "Again?"

dialogues.jp: 昔、あの頃、さくらと出会った日。
dialogues.en: The day I met Sakura a long time ago.
dialogues.text: The day I met Sakura a long time ago.

dialogues.jp:
あの日に取り戻した笑顔を、また失うかもしれ
ないなんて。
dialogues.en:
I'm afraid that I may not be able to see her smile again
like on that day.
dialogues.text:
I'm afraid that I may not be able to see her smile again
like on that day.

dialogues.jp: 「繰り返すのか」
dialogues.en: "...Happen again?"
dialogues.text: "...Happen again?"

dialogues.jp:
この島に帰ってきて夢を叶えた少女から、その
代償のように笑顔を奪うのか……。
dialogues.en:
How can they take her smile away from the girl who just came
back and made her dream true in this island?
dialogues.text:
How can they take her smile away from the girl who just came
back and made her dream true in this island?

dialogues.jp: きゃはははは――。
dialogues.en: Hahahaha...
dialogues.text: Hahahaha...

dialogues.jp: くすくす――。
dialogues.en: Huhhhuhh..
dialogues.text: Huhhhuhh..

dialogues.jp: あはははは――。
dialogues.en: Hahahaha...
dialogues.text: Hahahaha...

dialogues.jp: 笑い声が、俺の横を通り過ぎていく。
dialogues.en: The sound of laughs goes by me.
dialogues.text: The sound of laughs goes by me.

dialogues.jp: 怖い無邪気さだった。
dialogues.en: The innocence terrifies me.
dialogues.text: The innocence terrifies me.

dialogues.jp:
説得とか、真実とか、誠実さとか――そんなも
のは関係なしに止められないことが分かってい
た。
dialogues.en:
I know that nobody can take that away by persuasion, truth
and sincerity.
dialogues.text:
I know that nobody can take that away by persuasion, truth
and sincerity.

dialogues.jp: 俺もそちら側の人間なのだ。
dialogues.en: But I'm on the other side now.
dialogues.text: But I'm on the other side now.

dialogues.jp: 一度動き出した歯車は止められない。
dialogues.en: You can't stop the gears from turning once they've started.
dialogues.text: You can't stop the gears from turning once they've started.

dialogues.jp: 痛感してしまった。
dialogues.en: I've become acutely aware of that.
dialogues.text: I've become acutely aware of that.

dialogues.jp:
俺も、この学園の中ではたったひとりの学生で
しかないのだ。
dialogues.en: I'm just a student at this school.
dialogues.text: I'm just a student at this school.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "What a pain in the neck!"
dialogues.text: "What a pain in the neck!"

dialogues.jp:
一度だけ振り返って、俺はいつものように重い
足取りで家路についた。
dialogues.en: I turn around and head home with a heavy trudge.
dialogues.text: I turn around and head home with a heavy trudge.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらの噂２◆
dialogues.en: ◆The rumor about Sakura 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆The rumor about Sakura 2◆

dialogues.jp:
久しぶりに眞子に会い、例のさくらが事故の現
場にいたという話が、学園中に広まっていると
いう話を聞く。
dialogues.en:
I met Mako after such a long time, and she told me that the
rumor that Sakura was at the accident scene is all over the
school.
dialogues.text:
I met Mako after such a long time, and she told me that the
rumor that Sakura was at the accident scene is all over the
school.

dialogues.jp:
そういう証拠がない中傷が嫌いな眞子は、自分
でも色々とフォローに回っていてくれているら
しい。
dialogues.en:
Mako was trying to check the rumor, since she didn't believe
it without evidence.
dialogues.text:
Mako was trying to check the rumor, since she didn't believe
it without evidence.

dialogues.jp:
そんな眞子に感謝しつつ、順風満帆だった日常
に、なにか曇りが見えてきたような気がしてし
まった。
dialogues.en:
I appreciated Mako's effort, but I felt something would
happen soon to disturb this smooth sailing.
dialogues.text:
I appreciated Mako's effort, but I felt something would
happen soon to disturb this smooth sailing.
